```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

# ---------------------------
# Function: add host/viral QC
# ---------------------------
add_host_viral_qc <- function(obj,
                             assay = "RNA",
                             layer = "counts",
                             viral_features = c("HA","NP","NA","PB1","PB2","PA","NEP","NS1","M1","M2"),
                             na_alias = c("NA","neuraminidase")) {

  # Seurat v5-safe counts fetch
  counts <- tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, layer = layer),
    error = function(e) GetAssayData(obj, assay = assay, slot = "counts")
  )

  feats <- rownames(counts)

  # Map neuraminidase alias: treat either "NA" or "neuraminidase" as viral
  viral_set <- unique(c(setdiff(viral_features, "NA"), na_alias))
  viral_present <- intersect(feats, viral_set)

  if (length(viral_present) == 0) {
    stop("No viral features found in this object. Check rownames(obj[['RNA']]) and your viral_features/aliases.")
  }

  host_present <- setdiff(feats, viral_present)

  # nCount: sum of UMIs
  obj$nCount_viral <- Matrix::colSums(counts[viral_present, , drop = FALSE])
  obj$nCount_host  <- Matrix::colSums(counts[host_present,  , drop = FALSE])

  # nFeature: number of detected genes (nonzero)
  obj$nFeature_viral <- Matrix::colSums(counts[viral_present, , drop = FALSE] > 0)
  obj$nFeature_host  <- Matrix::colSums(counts[host_present,  , drop = FALSE] > 0)

  # Optional sanity check totals (won't overwrite your existing nCount_RNA/nFeature_RNA)
  obj$nCount_host_plus_viral <- obj$nCount_host + obj$nCount_viral
  obj$nFeature_host_plus_viral <- obj$nFeature_host + obj$nFeature_viral

  return(obj)
}

# ---------------------------
# Apply to your 4 slices
# ---------------------------
viral_genes <- c("HA","NP","NA","PB1","PB2","PA","NEP","NS1","M1","M2")

slice22 <- add_host_viral_qc(slice22, viral_features = viral_genes)
slice23 <- add_host_viral_qc(slice23, viral_features = viral_genes)
slice42 <- add_host_viral_qc(slice42, viral_features = viral_genes)
slice43 <- add_host_viral_qc(slice43, viral_features = viral_genes)

df <- merge(slice22, slice23)
df <- merge(df, slice42)
df <- merge(df, slice43)

# ---------------------------
# Example plots (slice22)
# ---------------------------
p1 <- VlnPlot(df, feature = "nCount_host", pt.size = 0, group.by = 'orig.ident') +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)) 
p2 <- VlnPlot(df, feature = "nCount_viral", pt.size = 0, group.by = 'orig.ident') +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)) 
p3 <- VlnPlot(df, feature = "nFeature_host", pt.size = 0, group.by = 'orig.ident') +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)) 
p4 <- VlnPlot(df, feature = "nFeature_viral", pt.size = 0, group.by = 'orig.ident') +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)) 
df_vpos <- subset(df, subset = nCount_viral > 0)

p2 <- VlnPlot(df_vpos, features = "nCount_viral", pt.size = 0, group.by = "orig.ident") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000))
p4 <- VlnPlot(df, feature = "nFeature_viral", pt.size = 0, group.by = 'orig.ident') +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)) 
p1; p2; p3; p4

# Violin by your annotation column (slice22)
annot_col <- "first_type"
VlnPlot(slice22, features = c("nCount_host","nCount_viral","nFeature_host","nFeature_viral"),
        group.by = annot_col, pt.size = 0) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#compare datasets
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})
bin_to_grid55 <- function(sp,
                          sample_name,
                          scale_xy = 0.647,
                          width = 55,
                          assay = "RNA",
                          layer = "counts",
                          min_nCount = 10) {

  # scale coords
  sp@reductions[["SPATIAL"]]@cell.embeddings <- sp@reductions[["SPATIAL"]]@cell.embeddings * scale_xy

  # filter spots
  sp <- subset(sp, subset = nCount_RNA > min_nCount)

  # coords
  coords <- as.data.frame(sp@reductions$SPATIAL@cell.embeddings)
  colnames(coords) <- c("x", "y")
  coords$cell <- rownames(coords)

  # bin (CENTERED at 0; no boundary)
  coords <- coords %>%
    mutate(
      xbin = ggplot2::cut_width(x, width = width, center = 0, label = FALSE),
      ybin = ggplot2::cut_width(y, width = width, center = 0, label = FALSE)
    )

  coords$bin_id <- paste(coords$xbin, coords$ybin, sep = "_")

  # counts (Seurat v5 safe)
  counts <- tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(sp, assay = assay, layer = layer),
    error = function(e) GetAssayData(sp, assay = assay, slot = "counts")
  )

  # map each cell -> bin index
  bin_levels <- unique(coords$bin_id)
  bin_index  <- match(coords$bin_id, bin_levels)

  # assignment matrix (cells x bins)
  A <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = seq_len(nrow(coords)),
    j = bin_index,
    x = 1,
    dims = c(nrow(coords), length(bin_levels))
  )

  # genes x bins
  binned_counts <- counts[, coords$cell, drop = FALSE] %*% A
  colnames(binned_counts) <- bin_levels

  # bin coordinates (numeric)
  bin_xy <- coords %>%
    distinct(bin_id, xbin, ybin) %>%
    mutate(
      x = as.numeric(as.character(xbin)) * width,
      y = as.numeric(as.character(ybin)) * width
    )

  # total UMIs per bin
  total_umis <- Matrix::colSums(binned_counts)
  df <- bin_xy
  df$total_counts <- as.numeric(total_umis[match(df$bin_id, names(total_umis))])
  df$sample <- sample_name

  df
}
bin_to_grid55_host <- function(sp,
                               sample_name,
                               scale_xy = 0.647,
                               width = 55,
                               assay = "RNA",
                               layer = "counts",
                               min_nCount = 10,
                               viral_features = c("HA","NP","NA","neuraminidase","PB1","PB2","PA","NEP","NS1","M1","M2")) {

  # scale coords
  sp@reductions[["SPATIAL"]]@cell.embeddings <- sp@reductions[["SPATIAL"]]@cell.embeddings * scale_xy

  # filter spots
  sp <- subset(sp, subset = nCount_RNA > min_nCount)

  # coords
  coords <- as.data.frame(sp@reductions$SPATIAL@cell.embeddings)
  colnames(coords) <- c("x", "y")
  coords$cell <- rownames(coords)

  # bin (centered at 0)
  coords <- coords %>%
    mutate(
      xbin = ggplot2::cut_width(x, width = width, center = 0, label = FALSE),
      ybin = ggplot2::cut_width(y, width = width, center = 0, label = FALSE)
    )

  coords$bin_id <- paste(coords$xbin, coords$ybin, sep = "_")

  # counts (Seurat v5 safe)
  counts <- tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(sp, assay = assay, layer = layer),
    error = function(e) GetAssayData(sp, assay = assay, slot = "counts")
  )

  feats <- rownames(counts)

  # viral present in matrix (handle NA alias)
  viral_present <- intersect(feats, unique(viral_features))
  host_present  <- setdiff(feats, viral_present)

  # map cells -> bins
  bin_levels <- unique(coords$bin_id)
  bin_index  <- match(coords$bin_id, bin_levels)

  A <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = seq_len(nrow(coords)),
    j = bin_index,
    x = 1,
    dims = c(nrow(coords), length(bin_levels))
  )

  # genes x bins
  binned_counts <- counts[, coords$cell, drop = FALSE] %*% A
  colnames(binned_counts) <- bin_levels

  # bin coordinates (numeric)
  bin_xy <- coords %>%
    distinct(bin_id, xbin, ybin) %>%
    mutate(
      x = as.numeric(as.character(xbin)) * width,
      y = as.numeric(as.character(ybin)) * width
    )

  # host-only UMIs per bin
  host_umis <- Matrix::colSums(binned_counts[host_present, , drop = FALSE])

  # optional viral UMIs per bin (useful sanity check)
  viral_umis <- if (length(viral_present) > 0) {
    Matrix::colSums(binned_counts[viral_present, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    rep(0, ncol(binned_counts))
  }
  names(viral_umis) <- colnames(binned_counts)

  df <- bin_xy
  df$total_counts_host <- as.numeric(host_umis[match(df$bin_id, names(host_umis))])
  df$total_counts_viral <- as.numeric(viral_umis[match(df$bin_id, names(viral_umis))])
  df$sample <- sample_name

  df
}
```

```{r}
object_paths <- c(
  "/data/projects/punim2394/lung_curio_mouse_pr8/RCTD/day4/lungST_2_2_QCed_annotatedv1.rds",
  "/data/projects/punim2394/lung_curio_mouse_pr8/processed_data/annotated_lungST_2_3_QCed.rds"
)

sp1 <- readRDS(object_paths[1])
sp2 <- readRDS(object_paths[2])

df_day4rep1 <- bin_to_grid55(sp1, sample_name = "Day4Rep1", width = 55, scale_xy = 0.647)
df_day4rep2 <- bin_to_grid55(sp2, sample_name = "Day4Rep2", width = 55, scale_xy = 0.647)

df_combined <- bind_rows(df_day4rep1, df_day4rep2)
library(Seurat)

data.dir <- "/data/projects/punim2394/lung_visium_pub/day3"
image.dir <- normalizePath(data.dir, winslash = "/")

image <- Read10X_Image(image.dir, image.name = "tissue_lowres_image.png")
d3 <- Load10X_Spatial(data.dir = data.dir, image = image)

coords3 <- Seurat::GetTissueCoordinates(d3, image = names(d3@images)[1])

df_d3 <- data.frame(
  x = coords3$x,
  y = coords3$y,
  total_counts = d3$nCount_Spatial,   # UMIs
  sample = "GSE202322"
)

df_all <- bind_rows(df_combined, df_d3) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = c("Day4Rep1","Day4Rep2","GSE202322")))

```

```{r}
ggplot(df_all, aes(x = sample, y = total_counts, fill = sample)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, color = "black", scale = "width") +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
